Agent Name: Physics_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent attempted to programmatically locate the June 2022 arXiv paper using a broad query and then naively filtered results by checking for "2022-06" in the published field. When no match was found, they proceeded to access june_2022_paper['entry_id'] despite june_2022_paper never being set, causing a NameError. This unhandled variable and flawed search/filter logic broke the workflow at the outset, preventing extraction of the axis labels and derailing the process needed to identify the word “egalitarian” from the 2016 Physics and Society article.
